verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for a payments platform with a public API, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions API token scopes, permission-limited keys, or least-privilege credential issuance. Card spending permissions and MCC spend controls restrict card transactions, not API credentials, so they are an adjacent feature that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
